title: Comment on the Best build page "Today’s best build": I'd like to ask you list baseline and all of best build version including improvement detail. let's invest…

messages.text: I'd like to ask you list baseline and all of best build version including improvement detail. let's investigate and plan to do this.

Good idea. Right now the page only shows today's build, so the history isn't anywhere you can see it. My proposal to the lead:
(1) I write down the full history: the original page, then each best build in order (st6-rb, st6-rb plus the people-section fix, st6-rb2, today's best build, and the GPU preview that is still being checked). For each one: which fixes it added and what each fix improved, in plain words, with the measured numbers where we have them.
(2) A tools agent adds a 'Versions' section to the Best build page that shows that list, with the same six versions you can try from your Try-it links (C-036).
The lead decides and will confirm the plan here.

Good idea. Here's the plan.

What you'll see: a "Versions" section on the Best build page, oldest first:
• Baseline: the original site, nothing changed
• Each best build since then, with:
  – what it improved, in one plain line
  – the result: what got smoother, or "no worse" when it only does less work
  – what it costs, if anything
  – a Try-it link to open that version on your phone

Who does it:
1. The ops agent writes the version history: the 5 versions so far, each with its changes and results.
2. A tools agent adds the section to the page.
3. Each new best build adds its own line when it's made, so the list stays current.

Already there: the Try-it servers for the baseline and every version are still running (from T-076), so the links will work.

I'll post here when the section is live, in about 1 hour.
